snippet.title: Picaro - Roguelike Card Game | Nightforge Studios
snippet.description:
Master the cards. Conquer the dungeon. 🃏 Picaro is NOW AVAILABLE!

Dive into a unique roguelike card combat experience where every decision is life-or-death. Enter with nothing but your deck and wits, and use every card strategically to escape treacherous dungeons. Will you wield the diamond sword, heal with a heart potion, or flee to fight another day?

🔥 Wishlist on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3909120/Picaro/
🔜 Coming soon to Itch.io!

What makes Picaro unmissable?
https://nightforge.org/picaro

- Strategic Card Combat & Roguelike Dungeons
- Custom Deck Builder & Speedrun Mode
- Endless Mode & Global Leaderboards
- Full Controller Support & Immersive Soundtrack
Every card matters. Every decision counts. Every run tells a unique story. Will you master the art of Picaro?

#Picaro #CardGame #Roguelike #IndieGame #StrategyGame #NowAvailable
